structured.answer: The page showed me that every saving has two parts: where it sits (bank, קרן השתלמות, חשבון ניירות ערך) and what it's invested in (S&P 500, אג"ח, cash). So for me, the S&P through a חשבון ניירות ערך or through my קרן השתלמות looks worth checking, but it gave no fees or first step, so I haven't decided anything.
